description: Create an agent inbox: an email address on one of your mail domains, received on our mail servers. Send `address`, such as support@agents.acme.com. Its domain must be one of yours, with `kind` `inbox` and `status` `active` (list_mail_domains). `displayName` is the name people see beside the address, and `label` is a word that groups inboxes, like client-acme. Both are optional. The answer is `{ created, inbox }`. `inbox.id` is the id list_threads takes as `mailboxId`. Creating an address you already have answers it with `created` false. An address is lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, up to 64 characters before the @ (400 `inboxAddressInvalid`). These names are never inboxes: postmaster, abuse, fbl, mailer-daemon, noc, security, hostmaster, webmaster, usenet, news, www, uucp, ftp, admin, administrator, root, ssladmin (400 `inboxAddressReserved`). A domain that is not active answers 409 `inboxDomainNotReady`, with `details.domainState`. An address that another mailbox uses answers 409 `inboxAddressTaken`. An address you deleted stays yours to take back. Another workspace cannot take it for 90 days (409 `inboxAddressHeld`, with `details.until`). Your plan sets how many agent inboxes you can have and how much mail they store (402 PLAN_GATE). A workspace can ask for 1,000 addresses a day (429). To make many at once, use create_agent_inboxes.

address.description: The whole address, such as support@agents.acme.com, on an active agent-inbox domain of yours.

displayName.description: The name people see beside the address. Left out: made from the part before the @.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

label.description: A word or two to group and find inboxes, such as client-acme. Null takes it off.

name: create_agent_inbox
title: Create an agent inbox
